name: Terminal Executor
logic:
import subprocess
import re

# Extract the likely command from the task
# Example task: 'Run ls -la in terminal' -> 'ls -la'
cmd_match = re.search(r'run (.*?) (in|on|at|)', task.lower())
command = cmd_match.group(1) if cmd_match else task

print(f'AI ALERT: I am about to run the following command on your system: {command}')
try:
    # Run the command and capture output
    output = subprocess.check_output(command, shell=True, text=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    print('--- Command Output ---')
    print(output)
    print('----------------------')
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f'[!] Command failed with exit code {e.returncode}')
    print(f'[!] Error Output: {e.output}')
